$comment: Which catalogue packs (packages/pack-*/, by pack id) this add-on ships, and in which content asset.

npm run content (scripts/runtime/content.mjs) writes each bundle to assets/content/<file> (and public/assets/content/ for the dev server and the standalone build), with assets/content/index.json, which the add-on reads first.
manifest.json must declare every file it writes (the script says which are missing). A pack not named here goes into the bundle that lists "*"; without such a bundle it is left out of this add-on.

Each pack's dependsOn must ship too. Splitting the add-on family (docs/master-plan/02-platform-and-packaging.md, sections 2.1 and 2.2) gives each add-on its own build manifest beside its manifest.json: node scripts/runtime/content.mjs --addon <folder>.
